details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements are mutually consistent and build upon each other without contradiction. The summary follows a clear structure: overview of annual performance (S1-S4), segment performance analysis (S5-S10), cost management and financing details (S11-S13), investment activities (S14), liquidity position (S15-S16), and forward-looking statements (S17). Explanations for changes (e.g., macroeconomic conditions, regulatory changes, sector-specific factors) are logically connected to the reported results. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the relationships between segment performances and consolidated figures are presented without implying arithmetic contradictions. The progression from consolidated results to segment details to cost management and finally to forward-looking strategies creates a coherent narrative.
